summary: Palestinian residents reported that masked settlers set fire to the Nawaj'a family home while family members were inside; the family escaped and the home burned.
discovery_sources: WAFA 2026-08-20; OCHA Protection of Civilians 2026-08-28; Land Research Center field report; Times of Israel 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-25
resolution_notes: Multiple Palestinian/UN/field-report routes document the fire, displacement and resident allegation of a settler attack, and exact fire/aftermath video exists. However, Israel Police initially said investigators found an electrical failure and no accelerant. At an Aug. 24 remand hearing police had not produced the fire service's final report, and a police representative acknowledged the investigation was still ongoing and arson had not been ruled out. Preserve as Unresolved pending the final fire-origin finding; do not attribute the fire to settlers as established fact.
media_status: Exact incident fire/aftermath video recovered via Times of Israel/Anadolu/Snd, but no media is published while event attribution remains unresolved; no generic substitute used.
